ExcludedSite.description: A site the plan leaves unchanged.

Exclusion.description: Why a site is not edited.

oneOf.description:
A reference codix cannot bind, left unchanged under
`--exclude-unresolved`.
The name in a comment, a string or a macro body.

The name in another file: in a comment or a string of code, or
anywhere in a text file.

FileId.description:
A file or directory identity: its root-relative path with `/` separators,
the case found on disk, and symlinks resolved. The root itself is `""`.

Location.description:
A position in a file: its path as shown from the cwd, its root-relative
identity, and a 1-based line and column.

path.description: Path relative to the cwd, with `/` separators.

files.description: Files written, relative to the cwd.

left.description:
The references that may mean the renamed symbol and were left
unchanged, as the preview listed them: the code may no longer build.

next_undo.description: After an undo, what `undo` would revert next, if anything.

rebased.description:
Whether files had changed since planning, outside the edited
regions, so the plan was made again on them.

undo.description: Whether it was an undo: `undo` then goes on to the apply before.
